title: The Assam Assembly, Before and After 2023
name: Assam
intro: Assam was excluded from the 2008 delimitation. Its 126 seats ran on the 1967/1972 order for five decades — until the 2023 redelimitation redrew every boundary. Plate I is the old map as actually drawn, with 2021 results; Plate II is the 2023 order with 2026 results; Plates III and IV trace the change seat by seat.
The assembly map Assam retired in 2023

constituencies.name: Ratabari
constituencies.note: Retained as a Scheduled Caste reserved constituency with substantially revised boundaries. The earlier Ratabari Police Station-based constituency was replaced by areas of Ratabari Development Block, comprising specified Gram Panchayats and villages. Several fringe villages that earlier formed part of the old Ratabari thana were redistributed to neighbouring Patharkandi and South Karimganj constituencies to achieve population balance.
constituencies.extent: Ratabari thana [excluding the villages specified in item (i) of the Appendix] in Karimganj sub-division.

constituencies.name: Patharkandi
constituencies.note: Retained with substantially revised boundaries. The old Patharkandi Police Station area was replaced by Development Block- and Gram Panchayat-based boundaries. The constituency gained adjoining rural areas from the former Ratabari region while some peripheral villages were reassigned to North Karimganj and South Karimganj.
constituencies.extent: Patharkandi thana [excluding the villages specified in item (2) of the Appendix] in Karimganj sub-division.

constituencies.name: Karimganj North
constituencies.note: Renamed North Karimganj and reorganized with revised boundaries. The constituency now comprises Karimganj Municipal Board together with surrounding Development Block and Gram Panchayat areas. Several rural villages that earlier belonged to the old Karimganj North constituency were redistributed to neighbouring constituencies to create a more compact urban–rural seat.
constituencies.extent: Karimganj town and the villages in Karimganj thana specified in item (3) of the Appendix in Karimganj sub-division.

constituencies.name: Karimganj South
constituencies.note: Renamed South Karimganj with substantially revised boundaries. It now consists of selected parts of Karimganj, Ratabari and Patharkandi Development Blocks, replacing the earlier police station-based limits. The constituency gained villages from adjoining areas while transferring several northern villages to North Karimganj.
constituencies.extent: Karimganj thana [excluding Karimganj Town and the villages specified in items (3) and (4) of the Appendix] and the villages in Ratabari and Patharkandi thanas specified in items (1) and (2) of the Appendix in Karimganj sub-division.

constituencies.name: Badarpur
constituencies.note: Largely reorganized into the newly constituted Ramkrishna Nagar (SC) constituency. Major portions of Badarpur Development Block, together with parts of Dullavcherra, R.K. Nagar and South Karimganj Development Blocks were merged to form the new reserved constituency.
constituencies.extent: Badarpur thana and the villages in Karimganj thana specified in item (4) of the Appendix in Karimganj sub-division.

constituencies.name: Hailakandi
constituencies.note: Retained with substantially revised boundaries. The old Circle No. 2-based constituency was replaced by Hailakandi Development Block and adjoining Gram Panchayats. Several villages were exchanged with Algapur and Katlicherra to equalize population.
constituencies.extent: Circle No. 2 (excluding Lala town) in Hailakandi thana Hailakandi sub-division.

constituencies.name: Katlicherra
constituencies.note: Reorganized and merged with Algapur to create the Algapur–Katlicherra constituency. Includes large parts of Katlicherra Development Block, together with portions of Lala, Hailakandi, Algapur, and South Hailakandi Development Blocks, replacing the earlier police station-based constituency.
constituencies.extent: Katlichera thana and Circle No. 3 (Part) and Lala town in Circle No. 2 in Hailakandi thana in Hailakandi sub-division.

constituencies.name: Algapur
constituencies.note: Merged with parts of the former Katlicherra constituency to form the Algapur–Katlicherra constituency. Comprises parts of Algapur, Hailakandi, Katlicherra, Lala, and South Hailakandi Development Blocks, while areas around Mohonpur, Kalinagar, Matijuri-Paikan, Katlicherra G.P., Rangabak, and Sunacherra-Rupacherra were retained in Hailakandi.
constituencies.extent: Circle No. 1 in Hailakandi thana in Hailakandi sub-division; and circle Nos. 23 and 24 in Silchar thana in Silchar sub-division.

constituencies.name: Silchar
constituencies.note: Retained with substantially revised boundaries. Silchar Municipal Board remained the core of the constituency, but Wards 1–7 were transferred to Udharbond. It also lost Berenga, Neargram Bagpur, Bhagadahar Borjurai, Bhajantipur and adjoining rural Gram Panchayats to Sonai and Barkhola, making Silchar a predominantly urban constituency.
constituencies.extent: Silchar municipality and circle Nos. 34, 36A, 36B and 37 in Silchar thana in silchar sub-division.

constituencies.name: Sonai
constituencies.note: Retained with substantially revised boundaries. The constituency was reorganized around Sonai Development Block, gaining Berenga, Neargram Bagpur, Bhagadahar Borjurai and Dakshin Saidpur areas while transferring Nutan Ramnagar, parts of Ganganagar, Uttar Krishnapur and adjoining villages to Lakhipur and Dholai (SC).
constituencies.extent: Sonai thana [excluding circle Nos. 32 (Part), 65, 66, Boaligrant in circle No. 54 (Part) and Hill Punjee and forest villages] and circle Nos. 28 to 31 and 35 in Silchar thana and circle No. 58 (Part) in Dholai thana in Silchar sub-division.

constituencies.name: Dholai
constituencies.note: Continued as a Scheduled Caste reserved constituency with substantially revised boundaries. It now includes parts of Barjalenga Development Block, Narsingpur Development Block, Palonghat Development Block and portions of Sonai Development Block, replacing the earlier Dholai police station-based constituency.
constituencies.extent: Dholai thana [excluding circle No. 58 (Part)] circle Nos. 65, 66 and Hill Punjee and Forest villages in Sonai thana and circle Nos. 25,26 and CLEVER House T.E in circle No. 27 (Part) and forest villages in Silchar thana in Silchar sub-division.

constituencies.name: Udharbond
constituencies.note: Retained with substantially revised boundaries. Expanded by incorporating the entire Udharbond Development Block, Dolugram Gram Panchayat, parts of Badripar, Badri Chandpur, Borkhola Development Block, and Wards 1–7 of Silchar Municipal Board, transforming it into a mixed urban–rural constituency.
constituencies.extent: Udharbond thana and circle Nos. 32 (Part) and 33 in Silchar thana and circle Nos. 44, 45 and 46 in Lakhipur thana and circle No. 32 (Part) in Sonai thana in Silchar sub-division.

constituencies.name: Lakhipur
constituencies.note: Retained with substantially revised boundaries. Gained Palorbond Gram Panchayat, parts of Badri Chandpur, Binnakandi Development Block (excluding Rupaibali G.P.), parts of Lakhipur Development Block, Palonghat Development Block, Rajabazar Development Block, and portions of Sonai Development Block. At the same time, Lakhipur Nayagram G.P., Ganganagar, Darmikhal, Rukni, Palonghat, Bhubandahar, Didarkhush, Mohankhal Rammanikpur and Moniarkhal Gram Panchayats were excluded and reassigned to neighbouring constituencies.
constituencies.extent: Lakhipur thana (excluding circle Nos. 44, 45 and 46) and Boaligrant in circle No. 54 (Part) in Sonai thana in Silchar subdivision.

constituencies.name: Barkhola
constituencies.note: Retained with substantially revised boundaries. Expanded by incorporating Tapang Development Block, Barjalenga Development Block, Ghungoor West G.P., Bhorakhai G.P., parts of Borkhola Development Block, Katigorah Development Block, Silchar Development Block, Sonai Development Block and portions of Kalain Development Block, making it one of the largest and most diverse constituencies in Cachar.
constituencies.extent: Barkhola thana and circle Nos. 20, 21, 22 and 38 in Silchar thana in Silchar sub-division.

constituencies.name: Katigorah
constituencies.note: Retained with the standardized spelling Katigorah and substantially revised boundaries. The constituency gained Badarpur Municipal Board, Chandranathpur G.P., parts of Borkhola Development Block, Kalain Development Block, and Katigorah Development Block, while Salchapra Gram Panchayat and adjoining villages were transferred to Barkhola, creating a more balanced constituency.
constituencies.extent: Katigora thana in Silchar sub-division

constituencies.name: Haflong
constituencies.note: Retained as a Scheduled Tribe reserved constituency with substantially revised boundaries. The constituency continued to cover the entire North Cachar Hills district, with minor boundary adjustments to align with updated administrative units and electoral rolls.
constituencies.extent: North Cachar Hills district

constituencies.name: Bokajan
constituencies.note: Retained as a Scheduled Tribe reserved constituency with revised boundaries. Continued around Bokajan Development Block and adjoining areas, replacing the earlier police station-based limits.
constituencies.extent: Bokajan thana in Diphu sub-division

constituencies.name: Howraghat
constituencies.note: Retained as a Scheduled Tribe reserved constituency with revised boundaries based on Howraghat Development Block and adjoining administrative units. Some areas were redistributed with Diphu (ST) to improve territorial balance.
constituencies.extent: Howraghat thana [excluding Langfer and Duardisa (Part-i) mouzas] in Diphu sub-division.

constituencies.name: Diphu
constituencies.note: Retained as a Scheduled Tribe reserved constituency with revised boundaries centred on Diphu Development Block and surrounding areas. Former police station and mouza boundaries were replaced by Development Block-based boundaries.
constituencies.extent: Diphu thana and Langfer and Duardisa (Part-I) mouzas in Howraghat thana in Diph.

constituencies.name: Baithalangso
constituencies.note: The former Baithalangso (ST) constituency was reorganized, with a substantial portion forming the newly created Rongkhang (ST) constituency. The new constituency comprises Rongkhang Development Block, Donkamukam Municipal Board, and Jengkha Town Committee.
constituencies.extent: Baithalangso thana in Hamren sub-division.

constituencies.name: Mankachar
constituencies.note: Retained with substantially revised boundaries. Reorganized around Mankachar, Fekamari and South Salmara Development Blocks, absorbing most of the former Salmara South constituency after delimitation.
constituencies.extent: Mankachar thana and the villages in South Salmara thana specified in item (5) of the Appendix in Dhubri sub-division.

constituencies.name: Salmara South
constituencies.note: Constituency abolished. Majority of its territory merged into Mankachar, with minor boundary adjustments to neighbouring constituencies.
constituencies.extent: South Salmara thana [excluding the villages specified in items (5) and (6) of the Appendix] in Dhubri sub-division

constituencies.name: Dhubri
constituencies.note: Retained with revised boundaries centred on Dhubri Municipal Board, together with parts of Birsing Jarua, Gauripur and Rupshi Development Blocks. Several rural Gram Panchayats were transferred to Gauripur and Birsing Jarua.
constituencies.extent: Dhubri municipality and Dhubri thana [excluding Gauripur Town Committee and the villages specified in item (7) of the Appendix] in Dhubri sub-division.

constituencies.name: Gauripur
constituencies.note: Retained with substantially revised boundaries. Expanded by incorporating parts of Debitola, Hatidhura, Mahamaya, Nayeralga, Rupshi, Bilasipara and Birsing Jarua Development Blocks, while receiving villages from Golakganj and Bilasipara.
constituencies.extent: Gauripur Town Committee and the villages in Dhubri thana specified in item (7) of the Appendix, the villages in Golakganj thana specified in item (8) of the Appendix, and the villages in Bilasipara thana specified in item (9) of the Appendix in Dhubri sub-division.

constituencies.name: Golakganj
constituencies.note: Retained with substantially revised boundaries. Reorganized around Golokganj Municipal Board and parts of Agomoni, Gauripur, Hatidhura and Rupshi Development Blocks, while several Gram Panchayats were transferred to Gauripur.

constituencies.note: Constituency abolished. Majority of its territory formed the new Birsing Jarua constituency, while the remaining areas were merged into Bilasipara.
constituencies.extent: The villages in Bilasipara thana specified in item (10) of the Appendix, and Sapatgram town committee in Dhubri and Kokrajhar sub-divisions.

constituencies.name: Bilasipara East
constituencies.note: Renamed as Bilasipara and substantially reorganized around Bilasipara, Chapar and Sapatgram Municipal Boards, with parts transferred to Birsing Jarua and Gauripur.
constituencies.extent: Bilasipara town committee and Bilasipara thana [excluding Sapatgram town committee ard the villages specified in items (9) and (10) of the Appendix] in Dhubri sub-division.

constituencies.name: Gossaigaon
constituencies.note: Retained after the creation of Kokrajhar district. Reorganized around Gossaigaon and Kachugaon Development Blocks, while peripheral villages were transferred to Baokhungri and Dotma (ST).
constituencies.extent: Gossaigaon thana [excluding the villages specified in item (II) of the Appendix and Ward Nos. 1 and 2 of Sapatgram town committee] in Kokrajhar sub-division.

constituencies.note: Constituency abolished. Majority of its territory formed the new Dotma (ST) constituency, while remaining areas were merged into Baokhungri.
constituencies.extent: The villages in Gossaigaon thana specified in item (11) of the Appendix and the villages in Kokrajhar thana specified in item (12) of the Appendix, in Kokrajhar sub-division.

constituencies.name: Kokrajhar East
constituencies.note: Renamed as Kokrajhar (ST) and reorganized around Kokrajhar Municipal Board and adjoining Development Blocks, with minor areas transferred to Baokhungri.
constituencies.extent: Kokrajhar municipality and Kokrajhar thana [excluding the villages specified in items (12) and (13) of the Appendix] in Kokrajhar sub-division.

constituencies.name: Sidli
constituencies.note: Renamed as Sidli-Chirang (ST) following the creation of Chirang district (2004). The constituency was substantially reorganized around Sidli-Chirang Development Block, Basugaon Municipal Board, Kajalgaon Municipal Board, Bongaigaon Refinery Township (CT), and parts of Borobazar Development Block. Territory earlier spread across Kokrajhar was reorganized within the newly created Chirang district.
constituencies.extent: The villages in Kokrajhar thana specified in item (13) of the Appendix and Sidli thana in Kokrajhar sub-division.

constituencies.name: Bongaigaon
constituencies.note: Retained after the creation of Bongaigaon district. Reorganized around Bongaigaon Municipality, New Bongaigaon and Manikpur Development Block, while peripheral rural areas were transferred to Abhayapuri and Srijangram.
constituencies.extent: Bongaigaon (Part) thana in Kokrajhar sub-division; and Bongaigaon (Part) thana in Goalpara sub-division.

constituencies.name: Bijni
constituencies.note: Retained after the creation of Chirang district with revised Development Block-based boundaries and minor
constituencies.extent: Bijni thana [excluding the villages specified in item (14) of the Appendix] in Kokrajhar sub-division.

constituencies.name: Abhayapuri North
constituencies.note: Renamed as Abhayapuri and reorganized around Abhayapuri Municipal Board with parts of Boitamari, Manikpur and Srijangram Development Blocks.
constituencies.extent: The villages in Bijni thana specified in item (14) of the Appendix in Kokrajhar sub-division; and the villages in Abhayapuri thana specified in item (15) of the Appendix in Goalpara sub-division

constituencies.name: Abhayapuri South
constituencies.note: Constituency abolished. Majority of its territory formed the new Srijangram constituency, while the remaining areas merged into Abhayapuri.
constituencies.extent: Abhayapuri thana [excluding the villages specified in item (15) of the Appendix] in Goalpara sub-division.

constituencies.name: Dudhnai
constituencies.note: Retained with revised boundaries based on Krishnai, Kushdhowa and Rangjuli Development Blocks, with minor village transfers to neighbouring constituencies.
constituencies.extent: Dudhnai thana in Goalpara sub-division.

constituencies.name: Goalpara East
constituencies.note: Retained with substantially revised boundaries centred on Goalpara Municipal Board together with parts of Balijana, Krishnai and Rangjuli Development Blocks.
constituencies.extent: Goalpara thana [excluding the villages specified in item (16) of the Appendix] in Goalpara sub-division

constituencies.name: Goalpara West
constituencies.note: Converted from a General to an ST reserved constituency. Reorganized around Lakhipur, Balijana, Krishnai and Matia Development Blocks, while some villages were transferred to Jaleswar.
constituencies.extent: Lakhipur thana [excluding the villages specified in item (17) of the Appendix] and the villages in Goalpara thana specified in item (16) of the Appendix in Goalpara sub-division.

constituencies.name: Jaleswar
constituencies.note: Retained with substantially revised boundaries. Reconstituted around Jaleswar, Kharmuja and parts of Lakhipur and Balijana Development Blocks, while the former South Salmara segment was transferred to Mankachar.
constituencies.extent: The villages in Lakhipur thana specified in item (17) of the Appendix in Goalpara subdivision; and the villages specified in item (6) of the Appendix in South Salmara thana in Dhubri subdivision.

constituencies.name: Sorbhog
constituencies.note: The old Sorbhog thana was split. The Barpeta Road Municipal Board, Sorbhog Municipal Board and large parts of Sorbhog Development Block were transferred to the newly created Bhowanipur constituency. The remaining western villages continued in the reorganised Sorbhog constituency. Bijni area, which had already been excluded in 1976, remained outside this constituency.
constituencies.extent: Sorbhog thana (excluding Bijni and Ruposi mouzas; in Barpeta sub-division.

constituencies.name: Bhabanipur
constituencies.note: The former constituency comprising Bhabanipur mouza, Bijni mouza and Hastinapur mouza was completely reorganised. It absorbed large portions of Sorbhog, Gobardhana, Pakabetbari and Barpeta Development Blocks, replacing the earlier mouza-based boundaries with Development Blocks and Gram Panchayats.
constituencies.extent: Bhabanipur mouza in Barpeta thana; Bijni mouza in Sorbhog thana; and Hastinapur mouza in Patacharkuchithana, in Barpeta sub-division.

constituencies.name: Patacharkuchi
constituencies.note: The old constituency based on Manikpur, Uttar Bajali, Pub Bajali and Sariha mouzas was abolished. Most of these areas now form the Bajali constituency, while adjoining villages around Kalbari and Hathinapur were included in Bhowanipur.
constituencies.extent: Manikpur, Uttar Bajali, Pub Bajali and Sariha mouzas in Patacharkuchi thana in Barpeta sub-division; and Tihu mouza in Barama thana in Nalbari sub-division.

constituencies.name: Barpeta
constituencies.note: Retained but converted into a Scheduled Caste reserved constituency with revised boundaries.
constituencies.extent: Barpeta, Ghilajari and Howli mouzas in Barpeta thana in Barpeta sub-division.

constituencies.name: Jania
constituencies.note: The old Jania constituency was abolished. Most of the former Jania/Baghbar riverine belt became part of the newly created Mandia constituency, while northern villages adjoining Barpeta town were merged into Barpeta (SC).
constituencies.extent: Barpeta, Ghilajari and Howli mouzas in Barpeta thana in Barpeta sub-division.

constituencies.name: Baghbor
constituencies.note: Baghbar was retained with revised boundaries. The former thana-based constituency was reorganised using Development Blocks, with some adjoining char areas redistributed to Mandia.
constituencies.extent: Baghbar thana [excluding Jania (Part) and Titapani mouzas] in Barpeta sub-division.

constituencies.name: Sarukhetri
constituencies.note: The old constituency comprising Sarukhetri, Paka and Betbari mouzas was abolished. Northern Paka and Betbari villages were included in Barpeta (SC), whereas the southern Sarukhetri villages (such as Kaldi, Satala, Bhogdia and adjoining GPs) were merged into Chenga.
constituencies.extent: Sarukhetri, Paka and Betbari mouzas in Barpeta thana in Barpeta sub-division.

constituencies.name: Chenga
constituencies.note: Retained with substantially revised boundaries. Several villages from the former Jania constituency were incorporated.
constituencies.extent: Tarabari thana and Nowgaon mouza in Barpeta thana in Barpeta sub-division.

constituencies.name: Boko
constituencies.note: Retained as a Scheduled Caste constituency with revised boundaries based on Development Blocks. Former thana limits were replaced by Panchayat-based administrative units.
constituencies.extent: Boko thana (excluding Bongaon mouza) in Gauhati sub-division.

constituencies.name: Chaygaon
constituencies.note: Retained with revised territorial limits. Parts of Boko and Palasbari areas were redistributed while Development Blocks replaced the earlier thana-based structure.
constituencies.extent: Chaygaon thana (excluding Dakhin Sarubongsor mouza) and Bongaon mouza in Boko thana in Gauhati sub-division.

constituencies.name: Palasbari
constituencies.note: Retained with significant boundary changes. Urban expansion around Guwahati and Development Block reorganisation replaced the former mouza-based constituency.
constituencies.extent: Palasbari thana (excluding Dakhin Rani, Ramcharani and Bholagaon mouzas) and Dakhin Sarubongsor mouza in Chaygaon thana in Gauhati sub-division.

constituencies.name: Jalukbari
constituencies.note: Retained with major urban restructuring. Earlier mouzas and Guwahati wards were replaced by Municipal Corporation wards together with Rani Development Block and North Guwahati Municipal Board.
constituencies.extent: Pub-Bongsor mouza in Hajo thana, Sila Sinduri Ghopa mouza (Part) in Jalukbari thana, Sila Sinduri Ghopa mouza (Part) and Borbongsor mouza in Kamalpur thana, Sila Sinduri Ghopa mouza (Part) in Gauhati thana and Ward Nos. 3, 4, 6 and 7 in Gauhati city, in Gauhati sub-division.

constituencies.name: Dispur
constituencies.note: Retained with completely redrawn urban boundaries. Earlier Beltola, Panbari and Sonapur areas were replaced by Guwahati Municipal Corporation wards.
constituencies.extent: Panbari, Sonapur, Dimoria and the villages in Beltola mouza not included within Gauhati city and Ward Nos. 30, 31, 32, 33 and 34 in Gauhati city, in Gauhati sub-division.

constituencies.name: Gauhati East
constituencies.note: Constituency abolished. Its urban area was divided primarily among the newly created New Guwahati, the reorganized Dispur, and Guwahati Central constituencies to accommodate the rapid expansion of Guwahati city.
constituencies.extent: Ward Nos. 15 to 29 in Gauhati city in Gauhati sub-division

constituencies.name: Gauhati West
constituencies.note: Constituency abolished. Most of the former Gauhati West urban area became part of the newly constituted Guwahati Central, while the western fringe and adjoining rural areas were merged into the reorganized Jalukbari constituency.
constituencies.extent: Dakhin Rani, Ram Charani and Bholagaon mouzas in Palasbari thana and Ward Nos. 1, 2, 5 and 8 to 14 in Gauhati city in Gauhati sub-division.

constituencies.name: Hajo
constituencies.note: Retained with Development Block-based boundaries replacing the earlier thana-based constituency.
constituencies.extent: Hajo thana (excluding Pub-Bongsor mouza) and Paschim Borigog mouza in Rangiya thana, in Gauhati sub-division.

constituencies.name: Kamalpur
constituencies.note: Retained with revised boundaries based on Development Blocks and Panchayats instead of police stations and mouzas.
constituencies.extent: Kamalpur thana [excluding Barbongsor and Sila Sinduri Ghopa (Part) mouza] and Pub-Kacharimahal mouza in Rangiya thana in Gauhati sub-division.

constituencies.name: Rangia
constituencies.note: Retained (renamed spelling from Rangiya to Rangia) with revised Development Block-based boundaries.
constituencies.extent: Rangiya thana (excluding Pub-Kacharimahal and Paschim Borigog mouzas) in Gauhati sub-division.

constituencies.name: Tamulpur
constituencies.note: Retained with revised boundaries. Initially became part of Baksa district after 2003; presently falls in the newly created Tamulpur district.
constituencies.extent: Tamulpur thana in Nalbari sub-division.

constituencies.name: Nalbari
constituencies.note: Retained with extensive boundary changes based on Development Blocks and Municipal Board areas replacing the earlier mouzas.
constituencies.extent: Khata, Paschim Banbhag, Pub-Banbhag, Bahjani and Batahghila mouzas in Nalbari thana in Nalbari sub-division.

constituencies.name: Barkhetry
constituencies.note: Retained (modern spelling Barkhetri) with revised Development Block-based
constituencies.extent: Paschim Barkhetry, Madhyam Barkhetry, Pub-Barkhetry, Uttar Barkhetry and Upper Barbhag mouzas in Nalbari thana in Nalbari sub-division.

constituencies.name: Dharmapur
constituencies.note: Retained with reorganised Development Block and Gram Panchayat boundaries replacing the former thana/mouza-based limits.
constituencies.extent: Dharmapur, Khetri Dharmapur, Pakowa and Natun Dehar mouzas in Nalbari thana in Nalbari subdivision.

constituencies.name: Barama
constituencies.note: Retained as a Scheduled Tribe reserved constituency with revised Development Block-based boundaries.
constituencies.extent: Barama thana (excluding Tihu, Uttar Baska and Dakshin Baska mouzas) in Nalbari sub-division.

constituencies.name: Chapaguri
constituencies.note: Retained as a Scheduled Tribe reserved constituency with revised Development Block-based boundaries incorporating Baksa district areas.
constituencies.extent: Chapaguri and Kaklabari mouzas and Reserved forest in Patacharkuchi thana in Barpeta subdivision; and Uttar Baska and Dakhin Baska mouzas in Barama thana in Nalbari sub-division.

constituencies.name: Panery
constituencies.note: The former Panery constituency was abolished. Most of the Panery thana area was merged into Udalguri (ST), while its western and northern parts were reorganised into Mazbat through the redistribution of Development Blocks and Gram Panchayats.
constituencies.extent: Panery thana [excluding Hari Singa and Ambagaon (Part) mouzas] in Mangaldoi sub-division.

constituencies.name: Kalaigaon
constituencies.note: Retained as Kalaigaon, but with substantially revised boundaries based on Development Blocks. The Sarabari area, earlier excluded from Kalaigaon, was reorganised under the new administrative framework, and some peripheral areas shifted to Sipajhar.
constituencies.extent: Kalaigaon thana [excluding Sarabari (Part) mouza] in Mangaldoi sub-division.

constituencies.extent: Mangaldoi thana [excluding Chapai, Rangamati, Samabari (Part) and Dahi mouzas] and Sarabari (Part) mouza in Kalaigaon thana in Mangaldoi sub-division.

constituencies.note: The Scheduled Caste reservation was abolished. The former constituency based on selected Mangaldoi mouzas was reorganised into the present Mangaldoi constituency with Development Block-based boundaries and a substantially altered territorial composition.
constituencies.extent: Chapai, Rangamati, Samabari (Part) and Dahi mouzas in Mangaldoi thana in Mangaldoi sub-division.

constituencies.name: Dalgaon
constituencies.note: Retained with extensive territorial revision. The former Dalgaon thana was replaced by Development Block and Gram Panchayat units, while Orang and adjoining areas were redistributed among neighbouring constituencies.
constituencies.extent: Dalgaon thana [excluding Orang (Part) mouza]; in Mangaldoi subdivision.

constituencies.name: Udalguri
constituencies.note: Retained as a Scheduled Tribe reserved constituency but comprehensively reorganised. The earlier thana-based area was replaced by Development Blocks, and several villages were redistributed with Mazbat and Kalaigaon.
constituencies.extent: Udalguri thana [excluding Barsilajhar and Orang (Part) mouzas] and Hari Singa and Ambagaon (Part) mouzas in Panery thana in Mangaldoi sub-division.

constituencies.name: Majbat
constituencies.note: Retained with revised limits. The constituency now comprises Development Blocks instead of the earlier Majbat thana and incorporates reorganised portions of Orang and adjoining areas.
constituencies.extent: Majbat thana, Orang (Part) mouza in Dalgaon thana, Orang (Part) and Barsilajhar mouzas in Udalguri thana in Mangaldoi subdivision.

constituencies.name: Dhekiajuli
constituencies.note: Retained after major territorial revision. The former thana-based constituency was reorganised using Development Blocks, while Barchalla-related areas were separated into the revised Barchalla constituency.
constituencies.extent: Dhekiajuli thana (excluding Barchalla and Borgaon mouzas) in Tezpur sub-division.

constituencies.name: Barchalla
constituencies.note: Retained with substantially revised boundaries. Earlier comprising Barchalla and Borgaon mouzas, it was reorganised around Barchalla Development Block with redistribution of adjoining villages between Dhekiajuli and Tezpur.
constituencies.extent: Barchalla and Borgaon mouzas in Dhekiajuli thana and Bihaguri and Bahbari (Part) mouzas in Tezpur thana, in Tezpur sub-division.

constituencies.name: Tezpur
constituencies.note: Retained with revised territorial limits. The former Tezpur thana-based constituency was reorganised using Development Blocks, Municipal Board and Gram Panchayats, while peripheral areas shifted to Rangapara and Barchalla.
constituencies.extent: Tezpur thana [excluding Bihaguri, Bahbari (Part) and Garaimari mouzas] in Tezpur sub-division.

constituencies.name: Rangapara
constituencies.note: Retained after significant boundary restructuring. Earlier based mainly on Rangapara thana, it now consists of Development Block areas with redistribution of Chariduar and adjoining villages.
constituencies.extent: Rangapara thana (excluding Charduar mouza )and Garaimari mouza in Tezpur thana in Tezpur sub-division.

constituencies.name: Sootea
constituencies.note: The former Sootea constituency was abolished and largely reorganised into the newly constituted Naduar constituency. The earlier Sootea thana area was redistributed using Development Blocks and Gram Panchayats.
constituencies.extent: Charduar mouza in Rangapara thana and Murhadal, Chilabandha, Barbhagia and Nagsankar mouzas in Sootea thana in Tezpur subdivision.

constituencies.name: Biswanath
constituencies.note: Retained with revised boundaries. The earlier Sootea thana-based constituency was reorganised into Development Block units, while some southern areas were transferred to Naduar and Behali.
constituencies.extent: Sootea thana [excluding Baghmara (Part), Murhadal, Chilabandha, Barbhagia and Nagsankar mouzas] in Tezpur sub-division.

constituencies.name: Behali
constituencies.note: Retained but converted into a Scheduled Caste reserved constituency. The constituency was reorganised using Development Blocks, with adjustments involving Biswanath and Gohpur areas.
constituencies.extent: Behali thana [excluding Halem and Brohmajan (Part) mouzas] and Baghmara (Part) mouza in Sootea thana in Tezpur sub-division.

constituencies.name: Gohpur
constituencies.note: Retained with revised boundaries. The former Gohpur thana-based constituency was reorganised around Development Blocks, while Halem and adjoining areas were redistributed following the new delimitation.
constituencies.extent: Gohpur thana and Halem and Brohmajan (Part) mouzas in Behali thana in Tezpur sub-division.

constituencies.name: Jagiroad
constituencies.note: Retained as an SC reserved constituency with substantially revised boundaries based on Jagiroad, Mayong and adjoining Development Blocks. Lost areas to Dhing and Morigaon while gaining reorganized rural areas.
constituencies.extent: Jagiroad thana and Pakaria, Uttar Khula (Part) and Ghagua mouzas in Marigaon thana in Marigaon sub-division.

constituencies.name: Marigaon
constituencies.note: Retained with revised boundaries centred on Morigaon Municipality and adjoining Development Blocks. Areas redistributed to Jagiroad (SC), Laharighat and Raha (SC).
constituencies.extent: Marigaon thana [excluding Pakaria, Uttar Khula (Part) and Ghagua mouzas], Mikirbheta thana (excluding Silpukhuri mouza) in Marigaon sub-division; and Barapujia mouza in Raha thana in Nowgong sub-division.

constituencies.name: Laharighat
constituencies.note: Retained with revised boundaries. Moirabari area was transferred to Dhing, while remaining areas were reorganized around Laharighat Development Block.
constituencies.extent: Laharighat thana (excluding Moirabari mouza) in Marigaon subdivision.

constituencies.name: Raha
constituencies.note: Retained as an SC reserved constituency but extensively reorganized. Expanded into former Morigaon and Nagaon areas using Kapili, Raha and Kathiatoli Development Blocks.
constituencies.extent: Raha thana (excluding Barapujia mouza); and Kampur thana (excluding Kampur mouza) in Nowgong sub-division.

constituencies.name: Dhing
constituencies.note: Retained but extensively reorganized. Expanded by incorporating Moirabari from old Laharighat and parts of Batadraba Development Block, while some areas shifted to Rupahihat.
constituencies.extent: Dhing mouza in Dhing thana, Alitangani mouza in Rupohihat thana in Nowgong sub-division; and Moirabari mouza in Laharighat thana in Marigaon sub-division.

constituencies.name: Batadroba
constituencies.note: Renamed as Nagaon–Batadraba and reorganized around Batadraba and Nagaon Development Blocks. Urban Nagaon areas were added while some rural areas shifted to Dhing and Raha (SC).
constituencies.extent: Dhing thana (excluding Dhing mouzah;) Hatichong Mouza in Nowgong thana in Nowgong sub-division; and Silpukhuri Mouza in Mikirbheta thana in Marigaon sub-division.

constituencies.name: Rupohihat
constituencies.note: Renamed (standard spelling) as Rupahihat with substantially revised boundaries. Expanded by incorporating areas from Juria, Kaliabor and Lawkhowa while losing some territory to Samaguri.
constituencies.extent: Rupohihat thana (excluding Alitangani and Lawkhoa mouzas) in Nowgong sub-division.

constituencies.name: Nowgong
constituencies.note: Old Nowgong constituency abolished. Nagaon town and surrounding areas became part of the newly constituted Nagaon–Batadraba constituency.
constituencies.extent: Nowgong Town mouza and Kachamari and Pakhimaria mouzas in Nowgong thana in Nowgong sub-division.

constituencies.name: Barhampur
constituencies.note: Retained with major boundary revision. Expanded using parts of Kampur, Kathiatoli and Kaliabor Development Blocks; some villages shifted to Nagaon–Batadraba.
constituencies.extent: Nizsahar, Singia Potani and Kondoli mouzas in Nowgong thana, Kampur Mouza in Kampur thana- Kathiatali Mouza in Jamunamukh thana, and Chalchali Mouza in Samaguri thana, in Nowgong subdivision.

constituencies.name: Samaguri
constituencies.note: Retained with revised boundaries. Expanded by incorporating Lawkhowa and parts of Rupahihat while losing some areas to Kaliabor and Barhampur.
constituencies.extent: Samaguri thana (excluding Chalchali and Duarsalna mouzas) and Lawkhoa mouza in Rupohihat thana in Nowgong sub-division.

constituencies.name: Kaliabor
constituencies.note: Retained with substantially revised boundaries. Reorganized around Kaliabor, Lawkhowa and adjoining Development Blocks, while several villages shifted to Samaguri and Rupahihat.
constituencies.extent: Kaliabor thana and Duarsalna mouza in Samaguri thana in Nowgong sub-division.

constituencies.name: Jamunamukh
constituencies.note: Constituency abolished. Majority of its area formed the newly created Binnakandi constituency, while remaining portions were merged into Hojai.
constituencies.extent: Jamunamukh mouza in Jamunamukh thana and Morajhar thana in Nowgong sub-division.

constituencies.name: Hojai
constituencies.note: Retained but reorganized. Boundaries revised around Hojai Municipality and adjoining Development Blocks. Before district bifurcation, the entire constituency lay in undivided Nagaon district.
constituencies.extent: Hojai thana and Lanka mouza in Lanka thana in Nowgong subdivision.

constituencies.name: Lumding
constituencies.note: Retained with revised boundaries centred on Lumding and Lanka areas. Before Hojai district was created, this constituency formed part of undivided Nagaon district.
constituencies.extent: Lumding thana and Kaki (part) mouza in Lanka thana in Nowgong sub-division.

constituencies.name: Bokakhat
constituencies.note: Retained with revised boundaries. The former Bokakhat thana-based constituency was reorganised using Bokakhat Development Block and adjoining administrative units. Some peripheral areas were redistributed with Khumtai and Dergaon to align with present district boundaries.
constituencies.extent: Bokakhat thana; Mahura mouza in Golaghat thana; and Rangamati mouza in Dergaon thana in Golaghat sub-division.

constituencies.name: Sarupathar
constituencies.note: Retained with revised boundaries. The old Sarupathar thana-based constituency now follows Development Block and municipal boundaries. Minor territorial adjustments were made with Khumtai and adjoining constituencies.
constituencies.extent: Sarupathar thana; and Morongi mouza in Golaghat thana in Golaghat sub-division.

constituencies.name: Golaghat
constituencies.note: Retained with substantial reorganisation. The constituency was redefined around Golaghat Municipal Board and Development Blocks instead of the earlier Golaghat thana and mouza boundaries. Some peripheral villages shifted to Khumtai and Bokakhat.
constituencies.extent: Ghiladhari, Kacharihata Athgaon and Mowkhow, mouzas (including Golaghat town) in Golaghat thana in Golaghat sub-division.

constituencies.name: Khumtai
constituencies.note: Retained after boundary revision. The earlier Khumtai and Dergaon thana-based areas were reorganised using Development Blocks. Villages were exchanged with Golaghat, Bokakhat and Dergaon for administrative continuity.
constituencies.extent: Khumtai, Dhekial and Dakhinhengera mouzas in Golaghat thana; and Dergaon thana (excluding Dergaona Kakodanga and Rangamati mouzas) in Golaghat sub-division.

constituencies.name: Dergaon
constituencies.note: Retained as a Scheduled Caste reserved constituency. The earlier constituency extending into Jorhat subdivision was reorganised entirely within present administrative units, with Jorhat-side villages redistributed to Jorhat constituencies.
constituencies.extent: Dergaon and Kakodanga mouzas in Dergaon thana in Golaghat sub-division; and Porbotia, Khangia, Sarucharai and Baligaon mouzas in Jorhat thana in Jorhat sub-division.

constituencies.name: Jorhat
constituencies.note: Retained with revised municipal and rural boundaries. The constituency now follows Development Block and municipal limits, while peripheral villages were redistributed among Teok, Titabar and Mariani.
constituencies.extent: Jorhat thana (excluding Porbotia, Khangia, Sarucharai, Baligaon and Hatigarh mouzas) in Jorhat sub-division.

constituencies.name: Majuli
constituencies.note: Retained as a Scheduled Tribe reserved constituency. Following the creation of Majuli district (2016), the constituency now lies entirely within Majuli district with revised administrative boundaries replacing the earlier subdivision-based limits.
constituencies.extent: Majuli thana in Jorhat sub-division.

constituencies.name: Titabar
constituencies.note: Retained with revised boundaries. The constituency now follows Development Block boundaries and exchanged villages with Mariani and Jorhat for administrative balance.
constituencies.extent: Titabar thana in Jorhat sub-division.

constituencies.name: Mariani
constituencies.note: Retained after territorial revision. The constituency was reorganised around Mariani Development Block, with adjustments involving Lahing and adjoining areas previously linked with Teok.
constituencies.extent: Mariani thana; and Lahing mouza in Teok thana and Tiru Hill Reserve Forest, in Jorhat sub-division.

constituencies.name: Teok
constituencies.note: Retained with revised boundaries. The earlier Teok thana-based constituency was reorganised using Development Blocks, while Lahing and adjoining villages were redistributed with Mariani.
constituencies.extent: Teok thana (excluding Lahing mouza) and Hatigar mouza in Jorhat thana in Jorhat sub-division.

constituencies.name: Amguri
constituencies.note: Retained with revised administrative boundaries. The former Amguri thana-based constituency now follows Development Block boundaries, with minor territorial changes involving Nazira and Sivasagar.
constituencies.extent: Amguri thana and Dopdar (part) mouza in Nazira thana in Sibsagar sub-division.

constituencies.name: Nazira
constituencies.note: Retained after extensive boundary revision. The constituency now comprises Nazira Municipal Board and adjoining Development Blocks, replacing the earlier Nazira thana-based limits.
constituencies.extent: Nazira thana [excluding Dopdar (part) and Silakuti mouzas] in Sibsagar sub-division.

constituencies.name: Mahmara
constituencies.note: Retained with revised boundaries. Following the creation of Charaideo district (2015), Mahmara now falls within Charaideo district and was reorganised using Development Blocks instead of the earlier Maranhat thana and Nazira mouza boundaries.
constituencies.extent: Maranhat thana and Silakuti mouza in Nazira thana in Sibsagar sub-division.

constituencies.name: Sonari
constituencies.note: Retained with revised boundaries. After the creation of Charaideo district, the constituency now lies entirely within Charaideo and follows Development Block-based administrative units.
constituencies.extent: Sonari thana in Sibsagar sub-division.

constituencies.name: Thowra
constituencies.note: Abolished. Most of the former Thowra constituency was merged into the reorganised Sivasagar constituency, while some adjoining areas were redistributed to Nazira and Sonari during the 2023 delimitation.
constituencies.extent: Panidihing, Nitaipukhuri, Thowra and Bakata mouzas in Sibsagar thana in Sibsagar sub-division.

constituencies.name: Sibsagar
constituencies.note: Retained with substantially expanded boundaries. The constituency absorbed most of the abolished Thowra constituency and was reorganised using Development Blocks and municipal areas instead of the earlier Sibsagar thana-based limits.
constituencies.extent: Sibsagar thana (excluding Panidihing, Nitaipukhuri, Thowra and Bakata mouzas) in Sibsagar sub-division.

constituencies.name: Bihpuria
constituencies.note: Retained as Bihpuria with substantially revised boundaries. The earlier Bihpuria thana was replaced by Bihpuria, Karunabari and Narayanpur Development Blocks along with Bihpuria and Narayanpur Municipal Boards. Several southern and eastern villages were transferred to Nowboicha (SC) and Ranganadi, while Narayanpur areas were incorporated into the constituency.
constituencies.extent: Bihpuria thana (excluding Laluk mouza) in North Lakhimpur subdivision.

constituencies.name: Naoboicha
constituencies.note: The former Naoboicha constituency was abolished. Its territory was divided mainly between the newly created Ranganadi and the reorganised Nowboicha (SC) constituencies. The old mouza-based boundaries were replaced by Development Blocks, with Lakhimpur, Karunabari and Nowboicha block areas redistributed.
constituencies.extent: Laluk mouza in Bihpuria thana and Naoboicha mouza in North Lakhimpur thana in North Lakhimpur sub-division.

constituencies.name: Lakhimpur
constituencies.note: Retained with major territorial reorganisation. The constituency shifted from the old North Lakhimpur thana to a combination of North Lakhimpur Municipal Board, Boginadi Development Block, parts of Lakhimpur Development Block, and parts of Nowboicha Development Block. Several rural areas were transferred
constituencies.extent: North Lakhimpur thana (excluding Naoboicha and Kadam mouzas) in North Lakhimpur sub-division.

constituencies.name: Dhakuakhana
constituencies.note: The constituency was retained but its reservation changed from Scheduled Tribe to Scheduled Caste. The former Kadam and Dhakuakhana mouza-based constituency was reorganised using Dhakuakhana Development Block, parts of Boginadi, and Ghilamara Development Block, while several areas were shifted to Lakhimpur and Nowboicha (SC).
constituencies.extent: Kadam mouza in North Lakhimpur thana and Gohain and Dhakuakhana mouzas in Dhakuakhana thana in Dhemaji subdivision.

constituencies.name: Dhemaji
constituencies.note: Retained as a Scheduled Tribe reserved constituency with revised boundaries. The earlier thana-based limits were reorganised using Development Blocks, while areas earlier linked with Dhakuakhana were separated following the new administrative arrangement.
constituencies.extent: Dhakuakhana thana (excluding Gohain and Dhakuakhana mouzas) and Dhemaji mouza in Dhemaji thana in Dhemaji sub-division.

constituencies.name: Jonai
constituencies.note: Retained as a Scheduled Tribe reserved constituency. The earlier Sissi mouza and Jonai thana boundaries were replaced by Development Block-based limits with only minor territorial adjustments.
constituencies.extent: Sissi mouza in Dhemaji thana and Jonai thana in Dhemaji subdivision.

constituencies.name: Moran
constituencies.note: Retained with revised boundaries. The earlier Moran thana-based constituency was reorganised using Mahmora and Lakwa Development Blocks, Moran Municipal Board, and adjoining Gram Panchayats. Areas earlier forming part of Moran were redistributed with Sonari and Duliajan under the Development Block-based delimitation.
constituencies.extent: Moran thana (excluding Lengeri mouza) and Lorua mouza in Dibrugarh thana in Dibrugarh sub-division.

constituencies.name: Dibrugarh
constituencies.note: Retained with substantially revised boundaries. The earlier Jamirah and Dibrugarh mouzas were replaced by Dibrugarh Municipal Corporation and adjoining Development Block areas. Urban expansion and redistribution of surrounding rural areas altered the constituency significantly.
constituencies.extent: Jamirah and Dibrugarh mouzas in Dibrugarh thana in Dibrugarh sub-division.

constituencies.name: Lahowal
constituencies.note: Retained with revised limits. The former Mancotta, Moderkhat, Lahowal and Rahmoria mouzas were reorganised into a Development Block-based constituency, with adjustments along the Dibrugarh urban fringe and neighbouring rural areas.
constituencies.extent: Mancatta, Moderkhat, Lahowal and Rahmoria mouzas in Dibrugarh thana in Dibrugarh sub-division.

constituencies.name: Duliajan
constituencies.note: Retained with major territorial reorganisation. The earlier Bordubi thana area was replaced by Duliajan Municipal Board and surrounding Development Blocks. Portions of the former Moran and adjoining areas were incorporated into the reorganised constituency.
constituencies.extent: Bordubi thana (part) in Dibrugarh sub-division.

constituencies.name: Tingkhong
constituencies.note: Retained with revised boundaries. The former Lengeri and Tingkhong mouzas were reorganised using Development Blocks and Gram Panchayats, replacing the earlier thana-based limits with only moderate territorial adjustments.
constituencies.extent: Lengeri mouza in Moran thana and Tingkhong mouza in Joypur thana in Dibrugarh sub-division.

constituencies.name: Naharkatia
constituencies.note: Retained with revised boundaries. The old Joypur thana-based constituency was reorganised around Development Blocks and Gram Panchayats, while maintaining its core territorial identity.
constituencies.extent: Joypur thana (excluding Tingkhong mouza) in Dibrugarh subdivision.

constituencies.name: Chabua
constituencies.note: Retained with revised limits. The earlier constituency extending across parts of Dibrugarh and Tinsukia subdivisions was reorganised using Development Blocks and urban local bodies, with boundary adjustments between Chabua and neighbouring constituencies.
constituencies.extent: Chabua thana and Ghorbondi (part) mouza in Tinsukia thana (part) in Dibrugarh sub-division; and Rangagora, Ghorbondi (part) and Bogdung (part) mouzas in Tinsukia thana (part) in Tinsukia subdivision.

constituencies.name: Tinsukia
constituencies.note: Retained with substantially revised urban boundaries. The earlier Tinsukia mouza and adjoining areas were replaced by Tinsukia Municipal Board/Corporation and surrounding Development Block areas reflecting urban growth.
constituencies.extent: Bardubi thana (part) and Tinsukia mouza in Tinsukia thana in Tinsukia sub-division.

constituencies.name: Digboi
constituencies.note: Retained with revised boundaries. The earlier Digboi thana-based constituency was reorganised using Development Blocks and municipal areas, while retaining the historic Digboi region.
constituencies.extent: Digboi thana [excluding Tirap (part) and Buridihing mouzas], Hapjan (part) and Tingrai (part) mouzas in Tinsukia thana and Tingrai (part) mouza in Doom Dooma thana in Tinsukia subdivision.

constituencies.name: Margherita
constituencies.note: Retained with revised limits. The former Margherita thana and adjoining Digboi areas were reorganised using Development Blocks and urban bodies, with minor territorial adjustments.
constituencies.extent: Margherita thana and Tirap (part) and Buridihing mouzas in Digboi thana in Tinsukia sub-division.

constituencies.name: Doomdooma
constituencies.note: Retained with revised boundaries. The earlier Doom Dooma thana and parts of Saikhowa mouza were reorganised into a Development Block-based constituency with limited boundary changes.
constituencies.extent: Doom Dooma and Hapjan (part) mouzas and the villages in Saikhowa mouza specified in item (18) of the Appendix in Doom Dooma thana in Tinsukia sub-division.

constituencies.name: Sadiya
constituencies.note: Retained with revised boundaries. The earlier Sadiya thana and remaining Saikhowa mouza areas were reorganised using Development Blocks and Gram Panchayats while preserving the constituency's eastern character.
constituencies.extent: Sadiya thana and Saikhowa mouza [excluding the villages specified in item (18) of Appendix] in Doom Dooma thana in Tinsukia sub-division.
